bibliographic.title: Warm The Sun
bibliographic.author: ozzymango
bibliographic.description:
With little more in common than trust issues and sexual chemistry, a soft girl in love with antiquities and a sepia boy in love with cash embark on perhaps the most ill-advised friendship of the century.

A little IF made for Amare. Part character study; part Varsity novel ; part meditation on queer Black Americana. It's cute, really.

Warm the Sun is very much a work-in-progress, containing chapter one so far, with several (at least) chapters planned. Please bear with the author; they are easily distracted, but doing their best..

CHAPTER ONE FEATURES
  • Lots of Words (too many maybe!)
  • A Sad Girl
  • A Sexy Guy
  • Social Awkwardness
  • Bisexual Longing
  • Two Endings

CONTENT WARNINGS
This story contains strong language, semi-explicit sexual content, under-age drinking, casual biphobia, as well as references to and brief descriptions of depression, anxiety, and mild dissociation. It is a story about college life, and is intended for those 18+
